properties.name: Thickness
properties.description: Wall thickness. 0 builds the air space as a solid body instead of a hollow shell

properties.name: SaddleGrowth
properties.description: Growth applied to the stub's base as it flares to conform to the run

properties.name: TrimRunA
properties.description: Trim length for run port A

properties.name: TrimRunB
properties.description: Trim length for run port B

properties.name: TrimBranch
properties.description: Trim length for the tap's own branch duct

properties.name: Attachment
properties.description: How the branch joins the run. Side: through the side of the run. Face: the branch passes over or under the run, and joins it with a collar and a 90 degree elbow. Auto picks one from where the branch is drawn

properties.name: ElbowRadius
properties.description: Centreline radius of the elbow of a face-mounted branch. 0 uses the branch size
